stops.name: Der Naturpark Niederösterreichische Eisenwurzen
stops.detail: The Nature Park Niederösterreichische Eisenwurzen is located in the Mostviertel, in the extreme southwest of Lower Austria. It is located entirely in the municipality of Hollenstein on the Ybbs. The eponymous ironroots are actually a much larger region and also extend to neighboring Styria. The nature park covers the entire Seeaubach valley and most of the Hammerbach valley. Hammerbach is a tributary of the Ybbs.
